q2_gaps: a framing/domain PP restricting a claim whose copular predicate must distribute over a group ('active in the present generation') — the instruction set anchors such a PP on 'what is claimed', but a distributed copular has no claim symbol, so no attachment site (group witness / per-member reified state / inside the rule's conclusion) is specified
notes: Counted plural takes the group + Cardinality 43, and the copular predicate distributes as (Implication (PartOf $x g) (Member $x active)) rather than riding the group symbol, both per doctrine; "present generation" is correctly left unfused as a descriptive modifier. Attaching the PP to the group with the preposition-named In (rather than LocatedIn, which a generation is not) is a defensible pick among the unspecified options.
